description: This file implements HTTP server utilities for MCP protocol, including server startup, address formatting, and request handling for SSE and streamable transports within the Playwright project.

methods.name: startMcpHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an MCP HTTP server with given configuration and backend factory, returning the server URL.

methods.name: addressToString
methods.description: Converts a network address object or string into a URL string with protocol and port, optionally normalizing loopback addresses.
